head_title: Clash of Clans Wiki — Troops, Spells, Heroes, Defences and Mechanics
description: An independent Clash of Clans wiki: every troop, spell, hero and defence explained by what it actually does on the battlefield, plus the game mechanics nobody writes down.
summary: Most Clash of Clans reference sites hand you a wall of numbers and leave you to work out what they mean. This wiki does the opposite. Every page starts with how the thing behaves, what it targets, what beats it and when it is worth your elixir, because that is the knowledge that survives a balance patch. Level tables are here too, and they are marked honestly when a figure is waiting on verification.

sections.body:
Every entry follows the same shape, so you can skim it in twenty seconds or read it in five minutes.

  • Quick facts at the top: role, housing space, targeting behaviour, what unlocks it.
  • Behaviour and mechanics: what the unit or building actually does, in words, including the quirks that are not in the in-game description.
  • How to use it and how to beat it: the two questions you actually came here with.
  • Stats by level: the number tables, at the bottom where they belong.

New to the game, or coming back after a long break? Start with the tutorials instead, then use the wiki as a reference while you play.

Every stat table on this wiki is read directly from Clash of Clans' own game files, pulled from Supercell's asset CDN. Not transcribed by hand, not scraped from another wiki. The client build they came from is printed under every table, currently version 18.350.7.

That version matters. It predates the June 2026 update, so a small amount of the newest content is not here yet, and we say so rather than letting you assume otherwise. We launched this wiki on an older source and discovered it was an entire Town Hall out of date; the methodology page tells that story, because stale data does not look stale, it just looks like data.

Where the files genuinely do not contain a value, the cell reads TODO rather than a guess. A dash means the field does not apply, which is a different thing. The written mechanics on every page hold regardless of balance changes; only the tables go stale, and now you know how stale.

faq.q: Is this the official Clash of Clans wiki?
faq.a: No. This is unofficial fan content, not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by Supercell. Clash of Clans is a trademark of Supercell Oy. For official information, patch notes and support, go to Supercell's own channels.

faq.q: How often is the wiki updated?
faq.a: Stat tables are regenerated whenever we read a newer build of the game files, and the build number under every table tells you which one you are looking at. Mechanics pages are reviewed when an update changes how something works.

faq.q: Do I need the Goblins Farm bot to use this wiki?
faq.a: No. The wiki, the tutorials and the news section are free reference material about the game and require no account, no download and no purchase. Goblins Farm also sells a farming bot, which is a separate product mentioned only in its own section of the site.
